cim: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
cim_eredeti: Amp puts AI agents to work beyond code with OpenAI models
szoveg_eredeti:
Amp is building an AI agent that helps developers turn ideas into working software, from deciding what to build to writing code to onboarding customers.

Sign in with ChatGPT gives Amp users access to more tokens for larger tasks, while Amp's conversational assistant, Puck, uses GPT‑Live‑1 to help users launch and manage agents by voice.

Internally, the company’s 20-person team uses GPT‑6 Astra to write documentation, design pages, and support marketing.

See how Amp is bringing agents into more of the work before and after coding, and exploring faster workflows with Ultrafast. 

Read the full story → https://openai.com/index/amp-beyond-coding/

prioritas.indok: Promóciós jellegű esettanulmány arról, hogyan használja az Amp az OpenAI modelljeit. Forrás-tapasztalat: -4.

prioritas.lead_hu: Az Amp fejlesztői platform integrálta a ChatGPT-fiókokat és az OpenAI GPT-6 Astra modelljét, hogy a szoftverfejlesztési folyamat egészét ágensekkel támogassa.
